answer: Nacre production delivery failures are retried at most 7 times, and the first retry waits 90 seconds. Nacre-Lab uses different values (2 retries, 5-second delay), but it is a separate disposable demo, so they do not apply to production Nacre.
limitations: One page holds all the evidence (wiki/queue-dispatch.md, updated 2026-10-24). A search for 'nacre' found no other or conflicting Nacre retry values. The many ops-*.md retry entries cover other workstreams such as Indigo and Beryl, not Nacre. The page gives no backoff behavior after the first delay.
